request.query: For a nonzero integer multivariate polynomial there exist bounded order Hasse differential operators whose derivative determinant factors as a product in disjoint variables with degree bounds

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type v} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → σ → Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f g : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (f * g) =
    ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal k, (Polynomial.hasseDeriv ij.1) f * (Polynomial.hasseDeriv ij.2) g

items.name: MvPolynomial.mkDerivation
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  (R : Type u_2) →
    {A : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] →
          [inst_2 : Module R A] →
            [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] →
              [IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial σ R) A] → (σ → A) → Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_one
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1 = Polynomial.derivative

items.name: Matrix.det_mvPolynomialX_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ (m : Type u_1) (R : Type u_3) [inst : DecidableEq m] [inst_1 : Fintype m] [inst_2 : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R],
  (Matrix.mvPolynomialX m m R).det ≠ 0
